# Getting help

| You want to | Go to |
|---|---|
| Install or deploy SmartSched | [docs/deploy/ONE-CLICK.md](../docs/deploy/ONE-CLICK.md), then [smartsched/deploy/README.md](../smartsched/deploy/README.md) |
| Understand how planning works | [docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md](../docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md) and [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) |
| Know whether a feature exists | [docs/STATUS.md](../docs/STATUS.md) (generated from `docs/features.yml`) |
| Report a bug | Issues → New issue → **Bug report** |
| Ask for a feature | Issues → New issue → **Feature request** |
| Report a vulnerability | [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md); never a public issue |
| Set up a development environment | [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) and [docs/DEVELOPMENT.md](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) |

Before opening an issue, search the existing ones and check [docs/ROADMAP.md](../docs/ROADMAP.md): many open
items are already tracked there.

SmartSched is maintained by a small team; there is no paid support. Questions about a specific university's
instance (accounts, rooms, its timetable) go to that university's planning office or IT helpdesk, not here.

## Private reports

For anything that must not be public (a vulnerability, a Code of Conduct report, personal data that ended up in an
issue), use the repository's **Security** tab → **Report a vulnerability**. Only the maintainers see it. Say in
the title when it is a conduct report rather than a vulnerability.

Türkçe: kurulum ve kullanım soruları için yukarıdaki belgelere bakın; hata bildirimi için **Bug report**
formunu kullanın. Güvenlik açıklarını ve davranış kuralları şikâyetlerini yalnızca **Security → Report a
vulnerability** üzerinden özel olarak bildirin.
